F.convention_note: Labels follow each language's espeak lexicon: English voiceless stops are unmarked for aspiration (p: sg -1) although phonetically aspirated in onsets; Mandarin aspiration is marked (ph: sg +1); Mandarin unaspirated b/d/g are labelled p/t/k (voi -1). Voicing and spread-glottis evidence therefore partly encodes the provider's implicit language choice, not only acoustics. Faithfully mapped, not collapsed.
